# AZ Elevated Builders

> Family-run, licensed and insured general contractor (CSLB #1106795) based in Brentwood, California, serving a 60-mile radius across the East Bay, Tri-Valley, Delta, Solano and Napa counties. Founded and run by Alfonso Zavala. Phone (925) 812-3150 · Azbuild3rs@gmail.com.

Key facts: free on-site estimates with a written scope; written warranty of up to 5 years on all work; financing available; every trade on the crew has 15+ years of experience in that specific trade; the team speaks English and Spanish (hablamos español). Services include kitchen and bathroom remodeling, whole-home remodels, additions and ADUs, concrete driveways and retaining walls, interior and exterior painting, flooring, drywall, cabinetry and countertops, finish carpentry, steam showers and saunas, and outdoor living. Business hours Monday-Friday 8am-6pm.

## Services

- [Kitchen Remodeling](https://azelevatedbuilders.com/services/kitchen-remodeling/): Layout, cabinetry, stone, lighting and fixtures — kitchens rebuilt to be the best room in the house.
- [Bathroom Remodeling](https://azelevatedbuilders.com/services/bathroom-remodeling/): Spa-level baths — tile, stone, steam showers, heated floors — waterproofed right from the rough-in.
- [Whole-Home Remodeling](https://azelevatedbuilders.com/services/whole-home-remodeling/): Interior and exterior remodeled as one project — layout, systems, finishes and paint under one crew.
- [Home Additions & ADUs](https://azelevatedbuilders.com/services/additions-adus/): New square footage that looks original — plus ADUs that earn rent or house family.
- [Concrete & Driveways](https://azelevatedbuilders.com/services/concrete-driveways/): Driveways, patios, walkways and retaining walls — formed, poured and finished by our own crew.
- [Interior & Exterior Painting](https://azelevatedbuilders.com/services/painting/): Full-prep painting inside and out — 22 years on the brush, straight lines, quality coatings.
- [Flooring Installation](https://azelevatedbuilders.com/services/flooring/): Hardwood, engineered, tile and laminate — plus radiant heat — installed flat, tight and clean.
- [Drywall Installation & Repair](https://azelevatedbuilders.com/services/drywall/): Hung, taped, textured and finished by a 20-year specialist — walls you'll never think about again.
- [Cabinetry & Countertops](https://azelevatedbuilders.com/services/cabinetry-countertops/): Custom and semi-custom cabinets with stone and quartz counters — one scope, lines that line up.
- [Finish Carpentry & Trim](https://azelevatedbuilders.com/services/finish-carpentry-trim/): Baseboards, casing, wainscot, built-ins and stairs — the details that separate remodels from renovations.
- [Steam Showers, Saunas & Heated Floors](https://azelevatedbuilders.com/services/steam-showers-saunas/): Spa features built from the rough-in — steam, sauna and radiant heat that work for decades.
- [Pergolas & Outdoor Living](https://azelevatedbuilders.com/services/pergolas-outdoor-living/): Pergolas, patios, landscaping and outdoor rooms — planned as part of the house, not an afterthought.
